capabilities.description: What the Dot and panel UI may call: event listening, Dot dragging, opening web pages (sign-in), the shell commands (hiding the rose and the full-screen panel included), and the computer-control commands (yolo mode included: its native confirmation decides).
Voice input (S30.1, S30.5): the panel's mic button records and transcribes natively, and the panel downloads, cancels, and removes the optional local voice model; the Dot never records.
The panel's Settings screen (S33): read and change the shortcut that opens the panel; the Dot never changes it.
Connector changes from the panel (S25.2): sent to the daemon over the app's private channel on behalf of the panel's window; the Dot and the web page cannot make them.
What the computer-control glow overlay (S28) may call: listening to the glow and session events, nothing else.
